title: Daily Reddit Digest
playbook: Install OpenClaw and connect a chat channel.
List your favourite subreddits and what you care about.
Schedule a daily curated digest summary.
notes: Community list; skills/plugins are not security-audited by the list maintainer.

title: Daily YouTube Digest
playbook: List channels you follow.
Have the agent check for new videos daily.
Receive short summaries in chat.
notes: Community list; skills/plugins are not security-audited by the list maintainer.

title: Inbox De-clutter: newsletter digest
playbook: Give the agent access to your newsletter emails.
Ask it to summarize newsletters.
Receive one digest email.
notes: Community list; skills/plugins are not security-audited by the list maintainer.

title: Personal CRM from email & calendar
playbook: Connect email and calendar.
Let the agent discover and track contacts.
Query contacts in natural language.
notes: Community list; skills/plugins are not security-audited by the list maintainer.

title: Family Calendar & Household Assistant
playbook: Connect all family calendars.
Get a combined morning briefing.
Let it watch messages for appointments and track household inventory.
notes: Community list; skills/plugins are not security-audited by the list maintainer.

title: Habit Tracker & Accountability Coach
playbook: Define the habits to track.
Set proactive daily check-ins via Telegram/SMS.
Agent tracks streaks and adapts tone to progress.
notes: Community list; skills/plugins are not security-audited by the list maintainer.

title: Health & Symptom Tracker
playbook: Log food intake and symptoms in chat.
Set scheduled check-in reminders.
Ask the agent to identify possible triggers.
notes: Community list; skills/plugins are not security-audited by the list maintainer. Not medical advice.

title: Podcast Production Pipeline
playbook: Give the agent an episode topic.
Agent does guest research and an outline.
It produces show notes and social promo assets.
notes: Community list; skills/plugins are not security-audited by the list maintainer.

title: Multi-Channel AI Customer Service
playbook: Connect your customer channels.
Unify them into one AI inbox.
Configure 24/7 auto-responses and review regularly.
notes: Community list; skills/plugins are not security-audited by the list maintainer.

title: Event Guest Confirmation by phone
playbook: Provide the guest list.
Agent calls each guest to confirm attendance and collect notes.
Receive a compiled summary.
notes: Community list; skills/plugins are not security-audited by the list maintainer.

title: Meeting Notes to Assigned Action Items
playbook: Feed meeting transcripts to the agent.
Get a structured summary.
Agent creates tasks assigned to the right person.
notes: Community list; skills/plugins are not security-audited by the list maintainer.

title: Client meeting prep briefing
playbook: Enable agent mode from the tools dropdown.
Prompt: "Look at my calendar and brief me on upcoming client meetings based on recent news."
Review the report.

title: Plan and shop a dinner party
playbook: Enable agent mode.
Prompt e.g.: "Plan and buy ingredients to make Japanese breakfast for four."
Log in when prompted; take over the browser anytime.

title: Competitor analysis slide deck
playbook: Enable agent mode.
Prompt: "Analyze three competitors and create a slide deck."
Edit the resulting slides.

title: Weekday competitor & market briefing
playbook: Create a scheduled Task.
Prompt: "Every weekday at 7:30 AM, compile a concise 5-bullet summary of competitor news, market shifts, and regulatory updates with links and a 2-sentence 'Why it matters.'"

title: Weekly key-account news scan
playbook: Create a scheduled Task.
Prompt: "Tuesdays at 9:00 AM, scan top 5 accounts for news on funding rounds, leadership changes, or major launches; summarize and flag possible revenue opportunities."

title: Meeting notes to owner task list
playbook: Prompt: "Turn the following meeting notes into a clean task list. The tasks should be grouped by owner and include deadlines if mentioned. Notes: [paste text]"
source_credit: OpenAI Academy — ChatGPT for any role

title: Vendor quote decision matrix
playbook: Collect vendor quotes.
Have the agent compare them and build a decision matrix.
Draft the PO email.

title: Quickly prep for your week
playbook: Connect calendar and mail connectors.
Ask Claude to prepare and prioritize your upcoming week.

title: Compare competing vendor proposals
playbook: Upload vendor proposals in any format.
Ask for a normalized comparison spreadsheet of pricing, contract terms and feature differences.

title: Turn emails into an event tracker
playbook: Share the email threads.
Ask Claude to extract dates, locations and logistics into a tracker.

title: Digital recipe cards from handwriting
playbook: Photograph handwritten family recipes.
Ask Claude to format them as digital recipe cards to save and share.

title: Plan your syllabus
playbook: Attach your syllabus.
Ask which weeks are locked by prerequisites and which can be rearranged.

title: Practice case interviews with feedback
playbook: Ask Claude to run a consulting case interview.
Work through it with structured frameworks and request feedback.

title: Shared brand-voice copywriter Gem
playbook: Create a custom Gem at gemini.google.com/gems/create.
Attach your brand playbook (up to 10 files).
Share the Gem with your team like a Google Doc.

title: Interview coach Gem
playbook: Create a Gem.
Attach your resume and the job description.
Practice interview questions with it.

title: Research docs to podcast-style overview
playbook: Add research documents to a notebook.
Click Audio Overview; prompt: "Generate a 15-minute podcast from @[Research Document] and @[interviews]."
source_credit: Google Workspace — Gemini at work guide

title: AI Gmail triage with draft replies
playbook: Import the template.
Add Gmail, OpenAI and Sheets credentials; set business context and signature.
Run in dry-run mode first, then enable. Replies are saved as drafts only.

title: Email summaries & labels logged to Notion/Sheets
playbook: Import the template.
Connect Gmail, Gemini, Notion and Sheets.
Each email is summarized, labeled and logged.

title: Fathom meeting summaries onto CRM leads
playbook: Trigger on a new Fathom AI summary.
Find the lead in Close by invitee email.
Create a note with the summary and recording link (only if a lead matches).

title: Summarize emails and post to Slack
playbook: Use the Make template.
Connect Gmail, OpenAI and Slack.
Email summaries are shared to a Slack channel.

title: Sheets content calendar to scheduled social posts
playbook: Keep post ideas in Google Sheets.
Template periodically filters rows and generates posts with OpenAI.
Posts are scheduled via Buffer.

title: Weekly newsletter digest drafted from RSS
playbook: Import the template; list your RSS feeds.
Runs Mondays: keeps last-7-day stories (max 25), drafts grouped HTML via OpenAI.
Saves a Kit draft broadcast or emails it to you to review.

title: Daily AI news to LinkedIn post draft
playbook: Import the template; add OpenAI and Gmail.
Add your tone/style prompt.
Each morning a LinkedIn post draft from last-24h articles is emailed to you for review.

title: Enrich new leads with ChatGPT, create in Salesforce, ping Slack
playbook: Use the Make template.
Connect OpenAI, Salesforce and Slack.
New lead company data is enriched with ChatGPT, the lead is created in Salesforce and the team is notified in Slack.

title: Reply to Google Business reviews with AI
playbook: Use the Make template.
Connect Google My Business and OpenAI.
New reviews get AI-generated responses; review replies before relying on them.

title: Log Google reviews to Airtable with draft ChatGPT replies
playbook: Use the Make template.
Monitor new reviews.
Create Airtable records with a ChatGPT-drafted response for your team to approve.

title: Turn a monitored website into social posts
playbook: Set up a Browse AI monitor on the site.
Use the Make template to summarize new content with ChatGPT.
Create social posts automatically.

title: New WordPress post to Facebook Page post
playbook: Use the Make template.
Watch for new WordPress posts.
OpenAI writes an engaging post and publishes it to your Facebook Page.

title: Draft blog posts from form submissions
playbook: Use the Zapier automation.
Submit topic ideas via a form.
AI drafts a blog post into WordPress or Google Docs for review.

title: Classify Google Forms responses with ChatGPT
playbook: Use the Zapier template.
Connect Google Forms and ChatGPT.
Each new response is classified automatically.

title: Structured feedback records from intake forms
playbook: Use the Zapier automation.
New feedback is categorized (theme, sentiment, request type).
A structured record is logged for review.

title: Transcribe sales calls and score lead qualification
playbook: Use the Zapier template.
Recorded calls are transcribed.
AI analyzes lead qualification and sends results via webhook.

title: Receipt photos to an expense sheet
playbook: Import the template (includes a step-by-step video).
Pick a Drive folder; copy the template sheet.
Drop receipts in the folder: vendor, date, items and total are logged and you get an email summary.

title: Invoice PDFs to booking list with auto-filing
playbook: Import the template; set input/output folders and chart-of-accounts sheet.
Upload an invoice PDF.
AI extracts fields, assigns a booking account, renames/files the PDF and updates the sheet.

title: Chat-upload invoices with Gemini, duplicate checks and email alerts
playbook: Import the template.
Upload an invoice via chat.
Gemini extracts and validates fields, checks Sheets for duplicates, logs it and emails the outcome.

title: WhatsApp receipt bot
playbook: Import the template; configure WhatsApp Cloud API webhook.
Send a receipt photo on WhatsApp.
It is stored, parsed, logged to Sheets and summarized back to you.

title: Weekly AI-curated RSS digest to your inbox
playbook: Import the template; list your feeds and recipient.
Runs Mondays 08:00: dedupes, keeps last 7 days, max 15 articles.
OpenAI groups them into 2–4 themes and emails an HTML digest.

title: AI meeting scheduler you CC on email
playbook: Install the Meeting Scheduler template.
CC Lindy on emails like you would an EA.
It checks availability and books the meeting.

title: Resume screening and top-candidate alerts
playbook: Use the resume screening template.
Receive resumes by email/Drive; AI scores by role.
Log scores to a sheet and alert Slack on high scores. Keep a human in the hiring decision.

title: 'Catch me up' briefing after time off
playbook: Connect Slack, email and meetings.
Ask Lindy to catch you up.
Get one briefing of what happened while you were out.

title: Close the loop after a meeting
playbook: Connect calendar and email.
After a meeting Lindy files action items, sends the follow-up, updates docs and schedules the next check-in.

title: AI sales researcher pre-call briefs
playbook: Clone the free Sales Researcher agent.
Give it a prospect.
Get a sourced pre-call brief (LinkedIn, web, hiring signals); optionally add Apollo/CRM tools.

title: Prospect research workflow
playbook: Follow the prospect research guide.
Configure research sources and output fields.
Run on your prospect list.

title: Summarize a week of emails on a project
playbook: Open Copilot Chat in Outlook.
Prompt: "Summarize my emails from the last week related to [project or customer name]."

title: Prioritize unread email (Copilot license)
playbook: Prompt: "Which unread emails are most important? Summarize them, synthesize any related context from my chats and documents, and prioritize the order in which I should respond."
notes: Requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on license.

title: Catch up on a Teams chat
playbook: Open a chat and select Open Copilot.
Try: "Summarize what I've missed." or "What were the key takeaways from last month?"

title: 30-day project synthesis across email, meetings and chats
playbook: Prompt: "Summarize all my emails, meetings, and chats over the past 30 days related to {topic}."
Then ask for all open action items for you on that topic.
Ask Copilot to draft a stakeholder announcement.

title: Copilot prompt gallery: who's waiting on me
playbook: Open the Copilot Prompt Gallery.
Use the prompt to find emails from the past 48 hours where someone is waiting on you.
Reply in priority order.

title: Build a balanced weekly work plan
playbook: Prompt: "Build a weekly work plan for [describe role or situation]. The week includes deadlines, meetings, and individual focus time. Provide a balanced schedule with recommended priorities."
source_credit: OpenAI Academy — ChatGPT for any role

title: Stakeholder project update draft
playbook: Prompt: "Draft a short project update for stakeholders. The project is [describe project]. Include progress made, current blockers, and next steps."
source_credit: OpenAI Academy — ChatGPT for any role

title: Build customer personas from research
playbook: Upload your research data (interviews, surveys).
Ask Claude to synthesize personas with demographics, goals and pain points.

title: Daily travel itinerary
playbook: Describe destination, dates and preferences.
Ask Claude for a day-by-day itinerary adapted to your desired activities.

title: Sentiment analyzer Gem for customer feedback
playbook: Open the premade Sentiment analyzer Gem.
Paste or attach customer feedback.
Ask for sentiment trends over time.
notes: Premade business Gems require a Gemini for Workspace add-on (per source).

title: Use a Gem inside Docs/Gmail side panel
playbook: Create a copywriting Gem pre-loaded with your audience.
Open Ask Gemini in the Docs/Drive side panel.
Use the Gem to draft posts without switching apps.
